bibliographic.title: SciDaSynth: Interactive Structured Data Extraction from Scientific Literature with Large Language Model

relevance_to_mlgg: RAG-based interactive extraction from scientific literature with cross-document validation and inconsistency resolution. Multi-modal (text + tables + figures). User study shows significant time savings with maintained quality.
key_methods: RAG framework for scientific document extraction
key_findings: Significant time reduction vs manual extraction
Interactive refinement improves extraction quality iteratively
actionable_for_mlgg: Cross-paper consistency checks when extracting batches (e.g., same dataset should have same n_patients)
Interactive mode for human review of low-confidence extractions
